actions.action: Separate imported attribution from verified identity
actions.mechanism: Explicit attribution states prevent imported labels or confidence scores from implying that a researcher verified the speaker.
actions.implementation: Store imported labels separately from reviewed identity. Default to unverified; allow unknown. Bind verification to reviewer, audio interval, and attribution revision.
actions.check: Import a confidently labeled segment; confirm it remains unverified. Save an unknown speaker without forcing an identity.
actions.risk: A generic verified badge could obscure which claim was checked.

actions.action: Version corrections and preserve saved quote history
actions.mechanism: Append-only corrections preserve evidence while saved collections resolve references to current revisions without overwriting earlier snapshots.
actions.implementation: Retain immutable imported text. Append corrections with segment ID, reviewer ID, reason, and parent revision. Store each saved quote’s original revision.
actions.check: Correct a saved quotation; confirm its collection shows the update and its original text, attribution, and reviewer history remain accessible.
actions.risk: Silently refreshing quotes could conceal changes; display revision differences.

actions.action: Represent boundary-crossing quotations as ordered spans
actions.mechanism: A quotation can reference multiple segments without inheriting the first segment’s speaker for its entire text.
actions.implementation: Store ordered segment IDs, text offsets, and audio intervals. Preserve attribution per span; display mixed or unknown identity when appropriate.
actions.check: Select a quote crossing two segments with different speakers, one unresolved; confirm both spans survive saving, playback, and export.
actions.risk: Combining adjacent spans may hide a real speaker transition.

actions.action: Review audio alignment independently of speaker identity
actions.mechanism: Editable audio anchors address incorrect timestamps without treating correct speaker attribution as proof that the interval is correct.
actions.implementation: Provide contextual playback and adjustable start/end anchors. Retain imported timestamps, version reviewed anchors, and record alignment verification separately from identity verification.
actions.check: Import an intentionally shifted interval; adjust it and confirm playback contains the entire quotation while imported timing remains available.
actions.risk: Unrecoverable alignment must remain visibly unresolved, not receive fabricated precision.

actions.action: Make export provenance inseparable from the quotation
actions.mechanism: An export contract carries attribution status and audio provenance into formats where interface warnings would otherwise disappear.
actions.implementation: Include revision, speaker or unknown, verification states, segment IDs, and recording-relative intervals with a stable audio route. Label provisional intervals explicitly.
actions.check: Export an unresolved speaker and a boundary-crossing quote; reopen each audio route and confirm warnings survive plain-text copying.
actions.risk: Audio access may expire; retain recording identifiers and interval coordinates.

actions.action: Expose attribution uncertainty directly in search results
actions.mechanism: Search distinguishes imported speaker claims from reviewed identities so retrieval does not silently endorse incorrect attribution.
actions.implementation: Label every result’s attribution state. Separate verified-speaker filters from imported-label filters; keep unknown speakers searchable and provide contextual audio playback.
actions.check: Search a name present only in an imported label; confirm the result cannot appear under verified-speaker filtering but remains discoverable elsewhere.
actions.risk: Hiding uncertain results by default could exclude valuable evidence.

actions.action: Invalidate verification when its supporting evidence changes
actions.mechanism: Verification applies to a specific claim and evidence revision, not permanently to a segment or quotation.
actions.implementation: Track dependencies on text spans, identity mappings, and audio anchors. Mark dependent verification stale after relevant corrections while preserving prior signoffs.
actions.check: Change a verified quote’s speaker mapping or interval; confirm saved collections and new exports no longer present its old verification as current.
actions.risk: Overbroad invalidation creates unnecessary review work; test dependency boundaries.

actions.action: Prevent competing reviews from silently overwriting decisions
actions.mechanism: Revision-aware writes expose conflicting corrections instead of allowing the last reviewer’s submission to become unquestioned truth.
actions.implementation: Require each correction to name its parent revision. Preserve conflicting submissions with reviewer identities; require explicit reconciliation before marking the disputed attribution verified.
actions.check: Have two reviewers correct the same revision to different speakers; confirm neither submission disappears and the unresolved conflict blocks current verification.
actions.risk: Reconciliation can stall; keep disputed quotations usable with explicit warnings.
